caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic bowl viewed directly from above. The bowl is primarily rendered in shades of reddish-brown, with a glossy appearance and a smooth, slightly concave surface. The rim of the bowl features a prominent swirling pattern in green and yellow, creating a continuous wavy band encircling the outer edge. Inside the bowl, there are decorative lighter tan or beige patterns forming an abstract or possibly floral design at the center. The drawing is centered on a plain, light beige background. Near the bottom of the image, the name "Roy S. Brown" is handwritten in cursive. There are some small stains and specks visible on the background around the bowl.
title: Plate
